scripts.generate-types: tmp=$(mktemp) && supabase gen types typescript --linked > "$tmp" && test -s "$tmp" && mv "$tmp" src/database.types.ts || (echo 'Type generation failed' && rm -f "$tmp" && exit 1)
scripts.generate-types:local: tmp=$(mktemp) && supabase gen types typescript --local > "$tmp" && test -s "$tmp" && mv "$tmp" src/database.types.ts || (echo 'Type generation failed' && rm -f "$tmp" && exit 1)
